primary_task: Add expo-observe to an Expo app and/or query and interpret EAS Observe performance metrics via `eas observe:*` CLI commands.

requirements.name: node/npm
requirements.check: command -v node npm; npm view expo-observe version

requirements.name: eas-cli
requirements.evidence: querying via the EAS CLI (`eas observe:metrics-summary`, ...)
requirements.check: command -v eas; npm view eas-cli version

requirements.name: expo (EAS)
requirements.evidence: EAS service (paid) ... EAS Observe is an Expo Application Services product

requirements.name: api.expo.dev
requirements.evidence: eas observe:* commands query EAS servers

requirements.name: mobile device / native build
requirements.evidence: needs a development or production build — the native library is not in Expo Go

notes: Ambiguous multi-purpose skill. Pure code integration (installing expo-observe, wrapping root) is doable, but the service itself (querying metrics, EAS project linkage) needs a signed-in Expo account and the Expo API, both missing/blocked here.
